scripts.install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.start: PORT=3001 npm run start:backend & PORT=3000 npm run start:web & wait
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && PORT=3001 npm run start
scripts.start:web: PORT=3000 cd web && npm run start
